parameters.question: Each row pairs an original protein sequence with a redesigned sequence produced by replacing every residue with a RANDOMLY chosen member of its conservative functional group (aliphatic, aromatic, positive, negative, polar uncharged, sulfur-containing, polar amide, proline). The redesigned sequences are stochastic and will NOT match the reference character-for-character — do not require string equality. Verify instead that: (1) the same set of original_sequence entries/IDs is present in both files, (2) each redesigned_sequence has exactly the same length as its original_sequence, and (3) each substituted residue belongs to the same conservative functional group as the original residue at that position. Column order may differ.
